title: Ingester counters
description: The ingester's own counts, across its profiles: totals since it started, except the levels buffered and oldest_buffered_ms. At every instant received = handed_on + buffered + shed.

received.description: Messages received from brokers, each counted on arrival.

handed_on.description: Captures the archive answered available for (committed or rejected there).

buffered.description: A level: captures waiting for the archive now.

bound.description: The most captures the ingester holds.

shed.description: Captures lost because the buffer was full when they arrived.

oversize.description: Of received, messages over the receive bound, handed on as a stub (size and hash only).

oldest_buffered_ms.description: How long the oldest waiting capture has waited since it arrived; null when none waits.
